scenes.line1: How does dbt boost data pipelines?
scenes.say: How does dbt help you build fast, reliable data pipelines? What makes it so efficient for modern teams?

scenes.label: Models
scenes.sub: Define SQL-based views and tables for transformations.
scenes.say: In dbt, models are SQL files that create views or tables. They let you transform raw data into useful formats.
You can declare sources for raw data, set up tests to check data quality, and dbt handles dependencies between models for you.

scenes.title: Incremental Model Example
scenes.say: Incremental models in dbt process only new or changed rows. This keeps your pipeline fast and efficient.

scenes.question: Can dbt only test for nulls?
scenes.right: No, dbt tests for uniqueness, referential integrity, and custom checks too.
scenes.say: Don’t get trapped! dbt does more than just null checks. It supports tests for uniqueness, referential integrity, and custom SQL-based checks.
